conventions.availability: param identifies the actor argument, or is null for a global behavior. types lists allowed own UnitTypeId names; with param=null it is an any-of prerequisite filter. ALL imposes no static type restriction and includes structures. conditions are additional human-readable runtime checks, not implemented filter code; type membership alone does not guarantee execution.
conventions.params: type uses shared_types.json names and generic/union syntax. required is independent of input and nullability; false means the Ares default permits omission. All model parameters, including optional ones, are part of this exported interface.
conventions.runtime: input is model or runtime. Runtime parameters declare a fixed value or a registered source identifier. default is the Ares constructor default; value is an explicit agent policy override.
conventions.defaults: Set and tuple defaults use JSON arrays and must be reconstructed using type. Mutable defaults are fresh per instance. default_python preserves the upstream Nydus bool/tuple mismatch without presenting it as a valid boolean.
conventions.scope: Catalog consumed by the action runtime. llm_exposure controls model visibility; input controls the parameter provider. Disabled actions remain available to trusted internal callers.
conventions.aliases: MoveSafely wraps PathUnitToTarget with the air grid. TacticalJump wraps UseAbility with EFFECT_TACTICALJUMP and requires a Point2 destination even though native UseAbility.target is optional.
